snapshot_note: Snapshot as of 2026-10-09. Every cell comes from the tool's own documentation on the date shown. Nothing here was installed or tested.

features.label: Installs as
features.description: Plugin, MCP server (a tool server the assistant calls), hook (an automatic session action), skill (instructions the assistant loads), CLI, library or app.
features.how_checked: Install section of the README or docs.

features.label: Works offline, no account
features.description: Everyday use needs no internet and no account. First setup downloads are noted separately.
features.how_checked: Install and configuration docs: required API keys, sign-up and network calls.

features.label: Memory you can open and edit
features.description: Saved memory lives in ordinary files you can read and change. A database or search index alone does not count.
features.how_checked: Docs on where memory is stored and in what format.

features.label: Footprint
features.description: Tiny: a script or plain files. Small: one local process or SQLite. Medium: a local database server or embedding model. Large: several services or a Docker stack. From documented dependencies, not measured.
features.how_checked: Dependencies listed in the install docs.

features.label: Claude Code
features.description: Documented support for Claude Code, and whether it can write memory or only read shared notes.

features.label: Codex
features.description: Documented support for OpenAI Codex (CLI or app).

features.label: Claude Desktop
features.description: Documented support for the Claude Desktop app, usually through MCP.

features.label: Windows
features.description: Runs natively on Windows, only under WSL2 (Linux inside Windows), or not documented.
features.how_checked: Install docs and release assets for Windows.

features.label: Kept after a crash
features.description: The docs say saved memory survives the assistant or the tool being killed.
features.how_checked: Docs on when memory is written to disk.

features.label: Kept after compaction
features.description: Memory stays reachable after the assistant shortens its conversation to save space.
features.how_checked: Docs on recall, session start and compaction hooks.

features.label: Undo or delete one memory
features.description: You can undo a change or delete a single memory; the cell names which.
features.how_checked: Command or API reference for edit, delete and history.

features.label: If its service stops
features.description: What still works when its background service or database is down.

features.label: Uninstall steps
features.description: Documented removal steps, and what is left behind.

features.label: License / cost
features.description: Open-source license, and whether a paid tier or cloud exists.

features.description: Stars on the main repository on the date checked.

features.description: Most recent release or tag, with its date.

tools.name: Plain Markdown folder
tools.description: Notes you save as ordinary .md files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, a notes folder) that the agent reads with its normal file tools. It does not capture or recall anything automatically on its own.
tools.source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Nothing to install: files in a folder

offline_no_account.value: Yes: just files; the agent itself still needs its own login

plain_files.value: Yes: Markdown you open and edit yourself

claude_code.value: Yes: CLAUDE.md is read at session start

codex.value: Yes: AGENTS.md is read at session start

survives_crash.value: Files on disk stay as last saved

survives_compaction.value: Project CLAUDE.md is re-read after compaction in Claude Code

undo_delete.value: Whatever your editor or git gives you

tools.name: claude-mem
tools.description: A plugin that watches what Claude Code does, summarizes it with an AI model, and feeds the summaries into later sessions.
tools.source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Plugin (hooks, local worker, MCP search tools)

offline_no_account.value: Partly: no account needed; summaries use an online model

plain_files.value: No: data is in SQLite plus a vector database

footprint.value: Medium: Node, Bun, uv, SQLite and a vector DB

claude_code.value: Yes, built for Claude Code; hooks capture and inject

codex.value: Yes, Codex CLI listed as a supported host

claude_desktop.value: Partial: a Desktop skill to search memory is listed

survives_compaction.value: Search tools usable mid-session; compaction not mentioned

uninstall.value: No uninstall steps found on pages read

tools.name: mem0
tools.description: A memory layer for AI apps that pulls out facts from conversations and stores them for search; for coding agents it is offered as a plugin that talks to Mem0's hosted service.
tools.source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Plugin or MCP to a hosted service; also an SDK

offline_no_account.value: No: plugin needs a Mem0 account and API key

plain_files.value: No: memories live in a vector store, hosted for the plugin

footprint.value: Small locally (plugin); the memory runs on a hosted service

claude_code.value: Yes: official plugin with MCP, hooks and a skill

codex.value: Yes: Codex plugin or direct MCP to hosted server

claude_desktop.value: Yes: custom connector to the hosted MCP URL

survives_compaction.value: Yes: pending capture saved at compaction; search stays

undo_delete.value: Delete one or all memories; no undo documented

uninstall.value: Plugin removal commands given; stored memories not discussed

license_cost.value: Apache-2.0; hosted Platform is a paid-tier service

tools.name: MemPalace
tools.description: A local search layer that stores your past conversations word for word and finds them again by meaning, organized into wings and rooms.
tools.source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI plus MCP server (also agent skills, Docker)

offline_no_account.value: Yes after setup; first use downloads an embedding model

plain_files.value: No: stored in a vector database (ChromaDB by default)

footprint.value: Medium: local embedding model plus vector store

claude_code.value: Yes: MCP server, auto-save hooks, mining of sessions

codex.value: Yes: auto-save hooks for Codex CLI, bundled plugin

claude_desktop.value: Not named in the pages read (checked 2026-10-09)

survives_compaction.value: Hooks save before context compression; recall by search

license_cost.value: MIT; a separate community-hosted service exists

tools.name: Graphiti (Zep)
tools.description: A Python library that turns text and chat history into a graph of people, things and facts with dates, stored in a graph database, with an optional MCP server so assistants can use it.
tools.source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Library (Python) plus MCP server in the repo

offline_no_account.value: Partly: needs a graph DB and an LLM key (local LLM possible)

plain_files.value: No: stored in a graph database

footprint.value: Large: graph DB (often Docker) plus an LLM service

claude_code.value: Not named; generic MCP server, so a client config is needed

codex.value: Not named in the docs read (checked 2026-10-09)

claude_desktop.value: Yes: stdio MCP setup described for Claude Desktop

undo_delete.value: Delete episodes; changed facts are marked old, not erased

license_cost.value: Apache-2.0; Zep sells a hosted version

tools.name: agentmemory
tools.description: A local memory server that records what your coding agent does through hooks, compresses it, and serves it back by keyword or meaning search.
tools.source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Local server plus plugin, MCP server, hooks, skills

offline_no_account.value: Yes in keyless mode; meaning search needs an embedder

plain_files.value: No: the engine's own store; JSON export available

footprint.value: Large: Node plus a separate engine on four local ports

claude_code.value: Yes: plugin with 6 hooks, skills and MCP

codex.value: Yes: plugin hooks verified with Codex CLI 0.150.1

claude_desktop.value: Yes: MCP config block for Claude Desktop

windows.value: Native with a manual engine install; WSL2 or Docker easier

survives_crash.value: Partly: up to 5 s of writes can be lost; more on Redis

survives_compaction.value: PreCompact hook re-injects memory before compaction

undo_delete.value: Delete or forget one memory; edits keep a version chain

service_failure.value: MCP shim falls back to a 7-tool local set if server is down

uninstall.value: agentmemory remove undoes what setup created

license_cost.value: Apache-2.0; no paid tier found in README

tools.name: Beads (bd)

tools.source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI (bd) that installs hooks, skills and AGENTS.md text

offline_no_account.value: Yes: embedded local database, no key or account

plain_files.value: No: Dolt database; the JSONL file is only an export

footprint.value: Small: one CLI with an embedded database

codex.value: Yes: bd setup codex installs skill, AGENTS.md text, hooks

survives_crash.value: Power loss is named as a corruption risk; repair steps exist

undo_delete.value: Version-controlled database; no undo command documented

tools.name: ai-memory (akitaonrails)
tools.description: A single program (a small server) that records what coding agents do, turns it into Markdown wiki pages kept in git, and hands context to the next agent, whether that is Claude Code, Codex or another.

installs_as.value: Local server (single binary) plus hooks and MCP config

offline_no_account.value: Yes: default path makes no LLM calls and needs no key

plain_files.value: Yes: git-backed Markdown wiki is the source of truth

footprint.value: Small: one binary plus SQLite, no model by default

claude_code.value: Yes: MCP config plus lifecycle hooks (read and write)

codex.value: Yes: MCP config plus lifecycle hooks

claude_desktop.value: MCP only in Chat; Code tab sessions are captured

survives_compaction.value: Search via MCP any time; compaction not described

undo_delete.value: Nothing hard-deleted; restore-page brings back old versions
